name: Coral Artichoke
headline: Coral Artichoke
description: Plant-based liver support — artichoke and milk thistle extracts with dandelion extract and betaine — that helps protect the liver and clear it of toxins. Useful for city dwellers, smokers and anyone who tends to over-do alcohol, fatty or spicy food.
howToUse: Adults – 1 capsule twice a day with food.

manufacturing.expiration: 2 years from the date of manufacture
manufacturing.storage: Store in a dry place, protected from direct sunlight, out of reach of children, at a temperature not above +25°C.
manufacturing.ingredients: Artichoke leaf extract, betaine hydrochloride, milk thistle seed extract, dandelion root extract, excipients.
